note:
STREAM-P4 §١ — HANDMADE FIXTURES FOR THE GROWING EVIDENCE SET.
The recorded archive cannot serve this gate: its answers carry no evidence rows at all, so
every unit in it is judged against an empty set from first character to last and the question
the gate asks — "does a row that arrives LATER change a unit that already went out?" — cannot
even be posed. These cases are built to pose it.

`arrivesAtUnit` is the 1-based index of the unit whose citation first brings the row into the
set. E_k is therefore every row with arrivesAtUnit <= k: the evidence in hand once unit k has
been written. E_0 is the empty set the answer starts with.

والصلاة على النبي مستحبة في كل وقت.
unitNotes: SHAPE ٤ — no attribution at all. This is the unit that goes out today, and the gate fails if it stops going out.
SHAPE ٢ — the row that supports this attribution is first cited in THIS sentence, so it is in hand when the unit is judged.
its own mas-ala: the row that supports it arrives with it. It is here so that the row of the NEXT unit is a real neighbour and not a stranger.

SHAPE ١ — the attribution here is supported by NOTHING in hand until unit 5. Under E_0..E_4 the reviewer strips the name; under E_5 it keeps it. Releasing it early is the defect this whole gate exists to catch.

mustNotSupport.why: SHAPE ٣ — binbaz:2 is the same scholar on the same official host, and it carries the same stance («مستحب»), so authority and officialdom both pass. The ONLY thing that keeps it away from unit 4 is that it is about a neighbouring mas-ala. If it ever supported unit 4, a sentence about عرفة would go out crediting a page about الأذان, and it would go out one unit EARLY.
